settings.editor: Dana Skaggs helps professionals banish their burnout with boundaries—leading to stronger engagement, clearer focus, and sustainable success.

settings.title: Worried a Boundaries Talk Will Backfire?

settings.editor:
Most leaders who book me start with the same question: won’t this just teach my team to say no to me?

Here’s what I’ve found. No boundaries means no control. The people with the weakest boundaries are usually your strongest performers — they absorb everything, flag nothing, and quietly burn out. Gallup found that employees who frequently experience burnout are 2.6× more likely to be job hunting.

They leave knowing exactly where their yard ends — and taking better care of what’s inside it.
